_doc: The scene list, as data rather than code, so the adversarial reviewer's must_fix[] can be applied as a diffable patch and any take is reproducible from a committed artefact. record_walkthrough.py reads this; nothing else defines the video.

scenes.shot: Title deck — Itch / Build / Proof, cross-creator claim hidden (unpaid promise, no scene shows two creators contradicting each other)
scenes.vo: The best career advice is locked in hour-long videos. You can't search it and you can't cite it. So I built something that can.

scenes.shot: Title deck — architecture, scrolled into frame
scenes.vo: One corpus, six ways to answer over it, one judge scoring all six on the same questions. Here's that architecture.

scenes.shot: Chat — resume question answered with timestamped citations, stale scope line hidden, self-grading opened into its own panel instead of a small pill
scenes.vo: Ask how to structure a resume summary — every claim links to an open source. Open the Faithful metric: it scores 0.94, and says plainly the model judged its own answer.

scenes.shot: Chat — document card (whole document, all 9 sections) + review answer citing document sections and corpus timestamps
scenes.vo: Point it at your own page and it reviews that document against the corpus. Your document supplies what gets critiqued; the transcripts supply the criteria, cited separately.

actions._why: The ask scene hides .rentry with an inline style; reloading the route restores the rail so this scene can pick its own conversation.
The trace carries the retrieval query — the criteria the corpus was searched for, not the words typed. It is what makes the citations checkable.

scenes.shot: Experiments — head-to-head matrix, engines x question types; narration now names both tagged runs visible in frame instead of claiming one
scenes.vo: Six engines, one RAGAS judge, same questions. Two tagged runs sit here — five questions and twenty. Scene five draws from the five-question run, 061607.

scenes.shot: Scoreboard — six setups ranked, then the efficiency chart scrolled fully clear of the caption
scenes.vo: Judged on the five-question run — too close to crown a winner on a one-point margin. What's decisive: the agentic loop burns eight times the tokens for no measured gain.
